# Stop Mork cursor loops on failed or invalid positions

A Mork cursor can fail or return a negative position or invalid object ID. Break the loop on those values before appending an operation ID or dereferencing a row, or corrupt summaries can trap enumeration.

Scope: mork.

Paths:

- `mailnews/db/msgdb/src/nsMsgDatabase.cpp`

## Evidence

[Shared lesson record](../records/35fa6a9612da2e0e4456e33ee451cb2c8f0a70f79c1337f4796a43a9ccc95a16.json).
